El: client/engine/replay.js calls it with (savedArenaConfig, savedArenaDefaultWalkable); it stores { bounds, walkableTiles, collisionMap } as the arena config in force
jl: inferred: compares a tile with minX..maxX and minY..maxY of the bounds of the arena config in force; the engine checks a player step's destination with it
Ol: client/engine/playerMovement.js stores its result as collisionMap; returns collisionMap of the arena config in force
Vl: client/engine/replay.js stores its result as savedArenaDefaultWalkable; the answer of the arena lookups when the config has no walkableTiles or bounds
cL: the engine iterates it as statName over playerStatDrains; its value is attack, strength, defence, ranged, magic
nm: handed to zebakDefinition as makeCollision: nm; returns { sizeX, sizeY, flags, getFlag, hasFlag, flag, unflag }
KT: flagged on the tiles of a standing pillar and unflagged from those of a destroyed one in the arena's collision map; CollisionFlag.OBJECT | CollisionFlag.OBJECT_PROJECTILE_BLOCKER
EG: inferred: a monster's footprint (resurrection tile, meleer dig-up tile) may not cover a tile with these flags; CollisionFlag.OBJECT | CollisionFlag.FLOOR_BLOCKED
Dj: inferred: a tile with these flags is not open for the player's start tile or a Jad healer (isOpen); CollisionFlag.OBJECT | CollisionFlag.FLOOR_BLOCKED
YH: the engine's canPlayerTargetActor(player, actor) returns it (client/engine/playerAttack/launch.js); inferred otherwise: alive and, for an NPC, without a death record
JH: inferred: alive and without a death record; the engine applies a freeze on launch only when it holds for the NPC target
QH: healNpc returns 0 and the hitpoint regen skips its tick when it is false; an alias of the NPC alive check
kM: its options are { attackRange, checkCollision, meleeReach } and its other arguments two footprints ({ southWest, width, height }); inferred otherwise
yT: inferred: false for a range of 0 or while the NPC overlaps the target, otherwise the footprint range test with collision and combat.meleeReach; the NPC pursuit stops moving when it holds for combat.attackRange
CM: the engine stores its result as npc.combat.startedTurnOverlappingTarget; it gates the decision site "npc.movement.overlap_escape"
wM: its result is stored under the key decisions (context.decisions ?? wM(context.random)) and as the engine's combatDecisions; error string "A weighted decision requires finite positive weights and a draw in [0, 1)"
AM: inferred: wraps each value as { value, weight: 1 }, the choices a decision's choose() takes
DM: its result is passed under the key decisions; context.decisions, or the random decisions made from context.random
RM: the fallback for targetPrayerMultipliers and the start of getPrayerMultipliers(); every multiplier is 1
PM: client/engine/playerAttack/plan.js stores its result as singleRollChance of (attackRoll, defenceRoll); elsewhere under the keys chance and accuracy
GM: inferred: (level + 9) * (offensive bonus + 64) of an NPC for a formula style; passed as the attack roll of the hit chance
UM: inferred: the effective defence level (with prayer multipliers and stance) times (the equipment's defence bonus for the style + 64); passed as the defence roll of the hit chance
$M: the fallback for maxHitOverride; Zuk stores the mean of its ranged and magic results under the key maxHit; it switches on attacker.kind ("npc", "player")
ZM: client/engine/playerAttack/launch.js stores its result as projectileFlightCycles; the modules pass it as endDelayCycles and projectileArrivalCycles; delay + lengthAdjustment + stepMultiplier * distance
pT: inferred: the Chebyshev distance from the centre tile of an NPC's footprint to a target's position; the distance of the projectile flight cycles
zG: it sets combat.nextActionTick to the tick plus a delay
NG: its result is passed in the projectiles of an "inferno_visual"; { spotAnimId, sourcePosition, target, startDelayCycles, endDelayCycles, slope, startOffset, startHeight, endHeight }
GG: it turns the actor to the target and emits "inferno_visual" (the attack clip and projectiles) and "zuk_attack" (attack: kind) for an NPC's attack
FG: it sets actor.facing from the centre of the actor to the centre of the target
FT: the registry's move() returns it for a definition without a move of its own; decision site "npc.movement.overlap_escape"; its result is a list of { npcId, path }
Ix: its result is passed under the keys position, sourcePosition and targetPosition of emitted events; returns [x, y] of a position
gG: handed to the "inferno-zuk" definition as targetsPlayer: gG; the renderer's zukShieldSafeTiles overlay marks the tiles where it is false; called as (shieldX, tile)
aI: the setup menu (client/assets/Grid.js) says ". Tap floor to move." when it holds for the start wave and " (fixed)" otherwise; waves 2 to 68
tI: client/assets/Grid.js stores its result under the key startTile (from state.startPlayerTile); it reads "x,y" into [x, y] or returns null
nI: its result is stored under the mechanics key "infernoStartTile" and the snapshot key startPlayerTile; `${x},${y}`
sI: returns { ok } or { ok: false, reason, message } with messages such as "The start tile [x,y] is under a standing pillar."
mI: inferred: rounds a wave and clamps it to 1..69 (1 when not finite); its result is written under the mechanics key "infernoStartWave"
vI: message "A spawn layout has ${vI} spawn tiles."; the length of the spawn tile table and of a layout's slots
pI: inferred: false for "nibbler" and "jad"; a wave with no kind left after it gets the error "no-slot-npcs"
kI: inferred: the kinds of a wave's monsters that take a spawn slot (error "no-slot-npcs" when it is empty); [] for a wave outside 1..68
yI: returns { ok: true, layout: { wave, slots } } or { ok: false, error, message } with messages such as "Spawn layouts are for waves 1 to 66."
LI: its result is stored under the snapshot keys startSpawnLayout and waveSpawnLayout and the mechanics key "infernoSpawnLayout"; `${wave}:` and one letter per slot
DI: its result is stored under the key spawnLayout of the setup read from the mechanics key "infernoSpawnLayout"; null for a string that is not a valid layout
GI: its result gates the key pinnedWave of the setup (mechanics key "infernoPinnedWave") and the command "keep-spawns"; waves 1 to 68 except 67
UI: its result is compared with a debug action's command type under visibleInPractice; "reroll-wave", "keep-spawns" or null for an encounter snapshot

GD: its value 7706 is the npcTypeId of archetypeId "zuk" (actors.js); npcTypeId: GD of the render entry whose clip "rise" is the spawn seq and of the portrait of "The Inferno" (heroArt zuk.png)
UD: its value 7703 is the npcTypeId of archetypeId "zuk_mager" (actors.js); npcTypeId: UD of the render entry with the clips magic and melee; a key of the Zuk fight's death-removal delays
jD: its value 7702 is the npcTypeId of archetypeId "zuk_ranger" (actors.js); npcTypeId: jD of the render entry with the clips range and melee; a key of the Zuk fight's death-removal delays
OD: its value 7704 is the npcTypeId of archetypeId "zuk_jad" (actors.js); npcTypeId: OD of the render entry with the clips magic, range and melee and holdDeathUntilRemoved
$D: its value 7705 is the npcTypeId of archetypeId "zuk_jad_healer" (actors.js); npcTypeId: $D of the render entry with the clips heal and melee
VD: its value 7708 is the npcTypeId of archetypeId "zuk_healer" (actors.js); npcTypeId: VD of the render entry with the clip heal and a spawnSeqId; a key of the Zuk fight's death-removal delays
aH: inferred: NPC type ids keyed by kind (nibbler, bat, blob, blob_mage, ..., jad_healer, pillar, pillarCollapse); compared with sourceNpcTypeId (aH.bat) and used as keys of the corpse species and death-removal tables
tH: getArenaConfig() returns bounds: { ...tH, width: 29, height: 30 }; the start tile check reads minX, maxX, minY, maxY from it ("The start tile ... is outside the arena.")
nH: mapSquare: nH in the registry descriptor of kind "inferno"; terrainMapSquare: nH in the render config
sH: mapSquareOffsets: sH in the registry descriptor of kind "inferno" and in the render config; entries { dx, dy }
rH: getDefaultPlayerStart() returns [...rH] when startWave is 69; wave 69's intro teleports the player to it (teleportPlayer([...rH], 1024))
iH: inferred: the offset from zukControlTick at which the intro begins (message "A great power is starting to shake the cavern...", playerInputLocked from zukControlTick + iH); also handed out as fadeOut: { offset: iH }
lH: at this offset from zukControlTick the intro calls teleportPlayer; error string "Wave 69's intro needs the engine's player teleport"
oH: inferred: the offset from zukControlTick at which the Zuk fight is created and its NPCs spawned with clip "rise"; the renderer adds it to zukControlTick for Zuk's spawn tick; also handed out as fadeIn: { offset: oH }
gH: inferred: from this offset to cH after controlTick, moveNpc() steps this.glyph one tile south per tick (from [30, 51] to its position [30, 48])
cH: inferred: the last offset after controlTick at which moveNpc() steps this.glyph one tile south
mH: its value is "rise"; passed as clipId of the animation of actorId "zuk" when Zuk spawns in the intro; the key of the render entry's attackClips that holds the spawn seq
hH: its text is "A great power is starting to shake the cavern..."; emitted as a "game_message" segment at the start of wave 69's intro
fH: its value is "Tzhaar-Ket-Keh"; passed as speaker of the public "game_message" of wave 69's intro
uH: its text is "No! TzKal-Zuk's prison is breaking down. ..."; emitted as a segment of the public "game_message" spoken by Tzhaar-Ket-Keh
vH: inferred: the position of the actor "zuk_shield" (this.glyph) when the fight starts from the intro (controlTick > 0); otherwise it spawns at [30, 48]
pH: excludedStaticLocIds: pH under collision in the registry descriptor of kind "inferno"
kH: its value is "inferno"; assigned to the encounter's field kind and returned as kind of getSnapshot()
SH: playerStart: [...SH] and collision seed in the registry descriptor of kind "inferno"; getDefaultPlayerStart() returns it for wave 1
bH: the fallback for startTile of the setup (key "infernoStartTile") and of getDefaultPlayerStart() on waves 2 to 68 when the chosen start tile is not valid
yH: passed as color of the "game_message" segments "Wave: N" and "Wave: 69"
zH: message "A spawn layout has ${zH.length} spawn tiles."; error strings "... is not a spawn tile" and "more slot NPCs than the nine spawn slots"; a spawn's position is zH[slot]
wH: the lower bound of the decision with site "inferno.layout.nibbler_x"
AH: the upper bound of the decision with site "inferno.layout.nibbler_x"
LH: the lower bound of the decision with site "inferno.layout.nibbler_y"
DH: the upper bound of the decision with site "inferno.layout.nibbler_y"
HH: the position of the one spawn of kind "jad" on wave 67; the wave-67 setup camera is aimed at the middle of its 5x5 footprint
MH: shuffled with site "inferno.layout.jad" into the positions of the three spawns of kind "jad" on wave 68
TH: inferred: { min, max } of the distance from a Jad's centre at which tiles are candidates for the decision with site "inferno.jad_healer.tile"

LC: indexed by variant ("zuk", "ordinary") when a ranger is created; entries { identity, attackRange, attackSpeed }, archetypeIds "zuk_ranger" and "inferno_ranger"
DC: stored (cloned) under formulaStats when the kind is "shield"; inferred otherwise: levels 1 and bonuses 0
HC: inferred: { npcTypeId, size, archetypeId } by kind (ranger, mager, jad, jad_healer) and variant (zuk, ordinary); looked up as HC[e.kind][e.variant] and spread into the actor that is built
MC: inferred: { npcTypeId, size, archetypeId } per kind string (zuk, shield, healer, nibbler, bat, blob, ...), spread into the actor that is built
TC: inferred: returns the { npcTypeId, size, archetypeId } entry for a kind string or a { kind, variant } pair; callers read .size of it
IC: its result is passed to the definitions' createActor(); error string "Missing Inferno monster data for ..."; it returns { id, kind: "npc", role, vitals, formulaStats, combat }
AG: its result is assigned to combat.retaliation ({ mode, pending, lastIncomingAttackTick }); the engine's error string "Unknown retaliation mode: ..."

LM: inferred: draws up to a count of different entries from a list with decisions.choose (key ordinal), removing each drawn entry; used for the sites "inferno.jad_healer.tile" and "zuk.jad_healer.tile"
HM: its result ({ decisions, tick }) is passed under the key labelled of rollNpcAttack
bT: inferred: the NPC did not start its turn overlapping the target and the target is within range (1 when plan.damageType is "melee", else combat.attackRange); it gates every monster's attack
xx: emits the event type "zuk_death"; the definitions' onDeathAnimation call it
MG: emits the event type "zuk_hit" (and the clip "defend"); handed out as onDamageResolved of the monsters' definitions
xG: inferred: the player or NPC named by combat.targetId while it can be attacked; otherwise the living player, who becomes combat.targetId; otherwise null
UG: inferred: a size x size footprint is walkable in the arena and none of its tiles has the collision flags OBJECT or FLOOR_BLOCKED; picks the mager's resurrection tile and the meleer's dig-up tile

jT: this.pillars is built from it (pillar: entry); entries { key, locId, position } with the keys west, south, northEast; message "... is under a standing pillar."
OT: dynamicLocs: OT under collision in the registry descriptor of kind "inferno"; one { locId, localX, localY, rotation, type, level } per pillar
$T: inferred: added to the tick to make removeAt of the collapse actor when a pillar's hp runs out (config.collapse)
VT: inferred: added to the tick to make removeAt of the collapse actors when the standing pillars are collapsed after wave 66
qT: stored (cloned) under formulaStats of the pillar and pillar-collapse actors; inferred otherwise: levels 1 and bonuses 0
ZT: inferred: the nine tiles of the 3x3 footprint at a pillar's position; the start tile check "is under a standing pillar" searches them
YT: refineArenaConfig() returns its result; inferred otherwise: flags the tiles of the intact pillars in a copy of the collision map and removes them from walkableTiles, and the reverse for the others
XT: the NPC definition with id "inferno-rocky-support"; its actors have archetypeId "inferno_pillar"
JT: the NPC definition with id "inferno-rocky-support-collapse"; its actors have archetypeId "inferno_pillar_collapse"
QT: its result is passed to createActor() of the pillar and pillar-collapse definitions; it returns { id, kind: "npc", role: "npc", size: 3, vitals, formulaStats, untargetable, combat }
eI: its result is spawned with id "inferno_pillar_<key>" and stored as the pillar's proxyId; archetypeId "inferno_pillar", hp 255

iI: inferred: the kinds a wave is made of (mager, ranger, meleer, blob, bat, nibbler, jad), in the order their spawns are listed and counted; entries become kind of { kind, count }
lI: error string "Inferno wave out of range: ..." guards the lookup lI[wave - 1]; 68 entries of counts per kind; a layout that does not fit has error "composition-mismatch"
oI: error string "Inferno wave out of range: ..." when it is false; an integer from 1 to 68
dI: error string "Inferno wave out of range: ..."; returns the wave's counts per kind, read as { kind, count }
gI: inferred: one kind per monster of the wave, in the order of the kinds list; the spawns ({ kind, position }) are mapped from it
HI: its result (encoded) is assigned to this.waveSpawnLayout; inferred otherwise: the { wave, slots } layout of a wave's spawns, or null unless every slot monster stands on a spawn tile
oU: inferred: keyed by wave 67 and 68; openingDelayTicks and rangedMagicPeriod go into a spawn's jad, healersPerJad is the count passed when a Jad's healers spawn
fj: inferred: hashes a seed, the wave number and a salt into one integer; the results seed the layout, NPC and nibbler pillar randoms
uj: its result is passed to openStream("npc", wave, ...) to make this.decisions; its salt 1313882963 is ASCII "NPCS"
vj: inferred: a Fisher-Yates shuffle of a copy, each swap drawn with decisions.int({ site, tick, ordinal }); sites "inferno.layout.jad" and "inferno.layout.slot"
pj: its entries ({ kind, position, jad }) are spawned with origin "wave"; decision sites "inferno.layout.slot", "inferno.layout.jad", "inferno.layout.nibbler_x"; error string "Wave ... has more slot NPCs than the nine spawn slots"

BH: handed out in debugActions (visibleInPractice at stage 69); its commands have encounter "zuk"
rI: its result is stored under the key startTile of the setup; inferred otherwise: the parsed "x,y" setting when it is a valid start tile, else the default start tile
jI: handed out in debugActions; its commands have encounter "inferno" (retry-wave, reroll-wave, keep-spawns)
OI: its value is "infernoStartWave"; the key of the mechanics toggle labelled "Start Wave" and of its default "69"
$I: its value is "infernoSpawnLayout"; the mechanics key read into spawnLayout of the setup
VI: its value is "infernoStartTile"; the mechanics key read into startTile of the setup
KI: its value is "infernoPinnedWave"; the mechanics key read into pinnedWave of the setup
qI: its values are "infernoWestPillarDestroyed", "infernoSouthPillarDestroyed", "infernoNorthEastPillarDestroyed"; the keys of the toggles labelled "West Pillar Destroyed", ...
ZI: inferred: Number() of a string of digits only, otherwise NaN; applied to the start wave and pinned wave settings
YI: its result is assigned to this.setup ({ startWave, zukShieldStart, destroyedPillars, spawnLayout, startTile, pinnedWave }); the registry entry reads .startWave of it for countdownMovement
QI: passed as info of the three "... Pillar Destroyed" toggles; its text is "Starts the run with this pillar already collapsed. ..."
eC: handed out as visibleInPractice of the Zuk toggles and debug actions; true when stage is 69
aC: inferred: adds section "TzKal-Zuk", visibleInPractice and appliesLater ("From wave 69") to a Zuk mechanics toggle
tC: handed out as controls: tC() in the registry entry of kind "inferno"; getDefaultMechanicsConfig() returns its defaultMechanicsConfig

CG: passed to the projectile builder (NG) of the attack of kind "bat_range", its timing to the flight-cycle formula; the blob stores the same shape ({ spotAnimId, timing, slope, startHeight, endHeight }) under the key projectile
jG: the NPC definition with id "inferno-jal-mejrah"; its death event has npcKind "bat"

OG: returns { clipId: "range", sound: "blob_range", projectile, plan }; its results are stored under the keys range and blob_range
$G: returns { clipId: "magic", sound: "blob_magic", projectile, plan }; its results are stored under the keys magic and blob_mage
VG: returns { clipId: "melee", sound: "blob_melee", plan }; its results are stored under the keys melee and blob_melee
KG: indexed by state.pendingRelease.style ("range" or "magic"; also .melee); error string "Jal-Ak ${style} has no projectile"; an entry's plan is passed as plan of rollNpcAttack
qG: its result is stored under the key style of state.pendingRelease; decision site "inferno.blob.style"; it answers Protect from Magic with "range" and Protect from Missiles with "magic"
ZG: called with state.pendingRelease.style at pendingRelease.releaseTick and from the definition's releaseOnDeathAnimation; error string "Jal-Ak ${style} has no projectile"
YG: the NPC definition with id "inferno-jal-ak"; its death event has npcKind "blob"
XG: indexed by actor.state.species (blob_mage, blob_range, blob_melee) in the definition whose death event has npcKind "blob_child"
JG: the NPC definition with id "inferno-jal-akrek"; its death event has npcKind "blob_child"
QG: its entries ({ species, offset }) become the splits ({ species, position }) of a removed blob, which the encounter spawns with origin "split"

mU: passed as plan of rollNpcAttack by the definition "inferno-jal-imkot"; the attack is presented with kind "meleer_melee"
hU: inferred: [x, y] offsets subtracted from state.dig.target to get the south-west tile the 4x4 meleer is tried on, in order, when it digs up (ability "meleer_dig_up")
fU: emits an "inferno_visual" with one animation { actorId, clipId }; called with the clips "dig_down" and "dig_up"
uU: it sets and clears state.dig and emits the abilities "meleer_dig_down" and "meleer_dig_up"; decision site "inferno.meleer.dig_interval"
vU: the NPC definition with id "inferno-jal-imkot"; its death event has npcKind "meleer"

pU: it stores config.getWaveTarget(context) (or the player once state.targetsPlayer) as actor.combat.targetId and returns that target
kU: the NPC definition with id "inferno-jal-nib"; its death event has npcKind "nibbler"

TG: passed as projectile of the plan of the attack "mager_magic"; the same shape ({ delay, lengthAdjustment, stepMultiplier, progress }) is the timing of the blob's projectiles
IG: passed as projectile of the plan of the attack "ranger_range" (ranger.js); the same shape is the timing of the blob's projectiles
WG: true for npcTypeId 7703 and 7699, the actors with archetypeId "zuk_mager" and "inferno_mager"
RG: true for npcTypeId 7702 and 7698, the actors with archetypeId "zuk_ranger" and "inferno_ranger"
PG: the command "demonstrate-set" returns its result ({ animations, projectiles, graphics }, clips "magic" and "range") as an "inferno_visual" event; the attack tick emits it the same way
bU: inferred: the lowest x of the tiles tried for the decision site "inferno.mager.rez.tile"
yU: inferred: the highest x of the tiles tried for the decision site "inferno.mager.rez.tile"
zU: inferred: the lowest y of the tiles tried for the decision site "inferno.mager.rez.tile"
wU: inferred: the highest y of the tiles tried for the decision site "inferno.mager.rez.tile"
AU: inferred: it filters the tiles offered to the decision site "inferno.mager.rez.tile": the footprint is walkable and overlaps neither the player nor an NPC the test counts
LU: emits the ability "mager_resurrect" (clip "resurrect") and the message "Jal-Zek uses his power to trigger the rebirth of a fallen foe."; calls resurrection.revive; decision site "inferno.mager.rez"; returns whether it did
DU: passed under the key choices of the attack selection (site "npc.attack.select"); its attacks are "mager_melee" and "mager_magic"
MU: the tick of the definitions "inferno-jal-zek" and "inferno-jal-xil" (tick: (e) => MU(e, choices, resurrection)); named after the engine's processNpcTick
TU: the move of the definitions "inferno-jal-zek" and "inferno-jal-xil"; it returns [] before state.stillUntilTick, else the pursuit moves
IU: the NPC definition with id "inferno-jal-zek"; its death event has npcKind "mager"
xU: inferred: sets spawnTick, combat.targetId (from initialTargetId), combat.retaliation and meleeReach "diagonal" on a new mager or ranger actor and returns it
BU: it builds the actor of kind "mager" and passes it to the "inferno-jal-zek" definition's createActor; the wave species "mager" and the command "spawn-mager" lead to it

HU: passed under the key choices of the attack selection (site "npc.attack.select"); its attacks are "ranger_melee" and "ranger_range"
CU: the NPC definition with id "inferno-jal-xil"; its death event has npcKind "ranger"
WU: it builds the actor of kind "ranger" and passes it to the "inferno-jal-xil" definition's createActor; the wave species "ranger" and the command "spawn-ranger" lead to it

zT: inferred: the range test of two actors' footprints with attackRange 1 and checkCollision true; it adds "melee" to Jad's style choices and gates the Jad healer's heal
BG: the command "demonstrate-jad" returns its result ({ animations, projectiles, graphics }) as an "inferno_visual" event; error string "Unknown demonstration style: ..."
aU: spread before config.melee into the plan of the attack "jad_healer_melee"
tU: returns the NPC whose id is actor.state.supportTargetId (the healer's parentId), or null
rU: it builds the actor of kind "jad_healer" and passes it to the "inferno-jad-healer" definition's createActor; spawnJadHealers and the wave species jad_healer call it
iU: registered with the "inferno-jad" definition as execution: iU ({ attackRange, initialDelayTicks, selectStyle, prayerCheckAtRelease, rangedMagicPeriod, profiles })
lU: inferred: the execution with initialDelayTicks 4; only the wave species jad (variant "ordinary") reads it, for the fallbacks of initialDelayTicks and rangedMagicPeriod
dU: the NPC definition with id "inferno-jad"; its death event has npcKind "jad"
gU: the Zuk fight's removeNpcIfDue calls it first and the encounter's reaches it through the wave removal; it despawns a Jad once the tick reaches state.removeAt and returns whether it did
cU: it builds the actor of kind "jad" and passes it to the "inferno-jad" definition's createActor; the Zuk fight's spawnJad and the wave species jad call it

SU: its entry for a defeated NPC's npcTypeId is stored under the key species of an entry of this.corpses (onNpcDefeated)
RU: inferred: indexed by npcTypeId; a dying wave monster is despawned once the tick reaches its deathAnimationTick plus this many ticks
PU: the encounter's removeNpcIfDue calls it for its combatants; it despawns the NPC and returns { actorId, npcTypeId, splits }, or null when not due
_U: error string "Unknown Inferno wave species: ..."; it switches on the species and returns what the species' definition's createActor returns
FU: passed as initialDelayTicks when origin is "resurrection"
kj: its value is "player"; passed as targetId of the wave monsters and of the wave's Jad
Sj: the fallback for jad.openingDelayTicks, passed as initialDelayTicks of the wave's Jad
bj: inferred: its results are the entries of the species table (nibbler: bj("nibbler"), ...); it returns a function ({ id, position, spawnTick, origin }) that creates the species' actor
yj: inferred: indexed by a wave spawn's kind, a split's or a corpse's species and "jad_healer"; the encounter calls the entry with { id, spawnTick, position, origin } and spawns the actor it returns

EU: the "inferno-glyph" definition's move returns its movement ({ npcId, path }) and copies its state (targetEndpoint, nextMoveTick) to actor.state; the snapshot's shieldNextX is the last tile of its path for the next tick
NU: the NPC definition with id "inferno-glyph"; its actors are created with kind "shield" (archetypeId "zuk_shield")
GU: it builds the actor of kind "shield" and passes it to the "inferno-glyph" definition's createActor; the Zuk fight stores its result as this.glyph
VU: passed as prayerReduction of the npcAttack Zuk returns for the attack "zuk_blast"; its type is "bypass"
KU: the NPC definition with id "inferno-zuk"; error string "Zuk requires formula stats"
qU: the attackTimer of the "inferno-zuk" definition returns it as nextAttackTick; state.firstCastTick, or state.lastCastTick plus the cast interval
ZU: inferred: the cast interval returned once the tick is past state.enragedAt (10 before that)
YU: the attackTimer of the "inferno-zuk" definition returns it as attackSpeed; 7 after state.enragedAt, otherwise 10

XU: constructed into this.sets of the Zuk fight; error string "Unknown Zuk clock: ..."; its getSnapshot() returns setTimer and timerPaused; the module's file name

_G: the command "demonstrate-heal" returns its result ({ animations, projectiles, graphics }, clip "heal") as an "inferno_visual"; the healer's tick emits its animations and projectiles before the event "zuk_healer_cast"
UU: the NPC definition with id "inferno-healer"; its death event has npcKind "healer" and its cast event the type "zuk_healer_cast"
QU: its result is passed under the key sparks, the property the command "emit-spark-volley" carries; three entries { position, amount, projectile, landing }
ej: constructed into this.sparks; its damage has source "ZukSpark"

aj: registered as the config of the "inferno-glyph" definition and passed to the shield's move planner; { endpoints, endpointPauseTicks }
tj: spread into the options of a respawned shield (command "respawn-glyph", enterBossHpPhase) and the fallback for the snapshot's shieldX; { position }
nj: its value is "zuk"; used as the boss actor's id, primaryActorId and in completionActorIds
sj: passed as position of the boss actor created with id "zuk"
